notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Eastern US Lookouts page gives only name and county. OpenStreetMap gives tower type and site elevation 25 m, which matches the record elevation_m; that is site elevation, not tower height, so height_m is left out. Coordinates conflict: the record uses OSM (30.10087, -83.453288); the Eastern US Lookouts page gives 30.10586, -83.44745, about 0.8 km away by our rough calculation. Neither was resolved from the sources. The Wikipedia and Taylor County history pages mention no tower. A Brooks-Scanlon water tower seen in search results is a mill structure, not a lookout, and was not used. The OSM edit note 'Add/modify communication mast' is a MapRoulette task label. Not listed on the NHLR or FFLOS Florida lists (checked 2026-10-21). Story is shorter than the 120-word guide target because the sources are thin; it was not padded. Research used two searches, one over the per-tower cap.
